result.summary: Export `replaces_txid` and `replaced_by_txid` from internal `wallet::CWalletTx` into the `interfaces::WalletTx` struct. In `MakeWalletTx`, populate both optional `Txid` fields from `wtx.m_replaces_txid` and `wtx.m_replaced_by_txid`.
result.problem: A prior cleanup removed `interfaces::WalletTx::value_map` from the main repository without re-exporting replacement transaction IDs. Downstream interface consumers, specifically the experimental QML GUI repository, lost access to transaction replacement details.
evidence: PR description references commit f4ff2b8db93 in bitcoin-core/gui-qml adding usage of `replaces_txid` and `replaced_by_txid`, followed by commit a2b0bfcd854 in bitcoin/bitcoin removing the backing `value_map` without exposing dedicated fields.
result.changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch or commit; diff and commit details are now confirmed.
result.card: Export replaces_txid and replaced_by_txid from internal CWalletTx through to interfaces::WalletTx. A previous refactoring in Bitcoin Core removed the generic value_map string table from WalletTx without exposing replacement identifiers, breaking transaction replacement tracking in the external QML GUI. This restores access to those transaction IDs via dedicated struct members.

risk.why: This is a 4-line read-only export of existing transaction metadata across internal interface boundaries.
